lb-2BL4.title: Plate: European-style with blue strip, red taxis
lb-2BL4.summary: Plates are long or short with a blue strip on the left. Taxi plates are deep red, and other colours exist too.

lb-3ac6.title: Landscape: large canyon to the south
lb-3ac6.summary: A large canyon visible to the south. The walker is near Bsharri.

lb-6bXU.title: Coverage: older walking-backpack camera
lb-6bXU.summary: Apart from the low-quality camera, all coverage was shot with an older Gen 3 walking backpack (blurrier, softer colours).

lb-AGko.title: Landmark: fortress on a single limestone rock
lb-AGko.summary: A fortress built on one huge limestone rock. It lies south-west of Tripoli.

lb-C649.title: Language: Arabic, plus English and French
lb-C649.summary: Arabic is the main script, but English and French are also common on signs.

lb-DdnD.title: Coverage: low-quality camera, Middle East
lb-DdnD.summary: Official coverage shot with a low-quality camera (blurry, poor colours). It is the only country in the Middle East with it.

lb-Dzfp.title: Coverage: rare backpack shots at attractions
lb-Dzfp.summary: Backpack coverage is very limited and mostly at tourist sights, university campuses and trails. Only the places you can pinpoint are covered in these notes.

lb-E5A0.title: Architecture: stone bottom floors, beige above
lb-E5A0.summary: Large stone buildings with unpainted bottom floors and beige-painted floors above. It is a university campus.

lb-Iemd.title: Landmark: large Roman ruins
lb-Iemd.summary: A big complex of Roman ruins. It is in Baalbek.

lb-JCQE.title: Landscape: flat fields, mountains to the northwest
lb-JCQE.summary: Flat farmland with mountains visible to the northwest. This is the region around Zahle.

lb-LBig.title: Architecture: urban campus, construction, big blocks
lb-LBig.summary: A campus with an urban feel: lots of construction work and large modern buildings. It lies east of the ancient coastal city.

lb-Lgc7.title: Landscape: Mediterranean hills and rocky cliffs
lb-Lgc7.summary: Mediterranean look with lots of hills and rocky cliffs.

lb-Mi4i.title: Coverage: only rural coastal road with walker shots
lb-Mi4i.summary: The only countryside coastal road with walking-backpack coverage in the country. It is south-west of Tripoli.

lb-RzjR.title: Architecture: modern sandstone on a forested hill
lb-RzjR.summary: Large modern sandstone buildings, spread out on a forested hill, with the sea far away to the west. It is a university campus.

lb-SrSV.title: Coverage: seaside promenade, grey bricks, fan palms
lb-SrSV.summary: A promenade with grey brick paving and many fan palms. This is part of the capital's seafront.

lb-cdUJ.title: Pole: metal mesh, sometimes bright yellow
lb-cdUJ.summary: Many poles are metal mesh towers, sometimes painted bright yellow. Plain wooden poles are common too.

lb-eF7M.title: Architecture: grand old sandstone building
lb-eF7M.summary: An old, grand-looking sandstone building. It is a university south-east of the capital centre.

lb-eRJg.title: Coverage: mostly near the west coast
lb-eRJg.summary: Most coverage is near the west coast, north of the capital.

lb-fPLp.title: Architecture: old buildings of unpainted stone brick
lb-fPLp.summary: Many old historical buildings, almost all made from the same unpainted stone bricks. It is one of the oldest cities in the world.

lb-i6sF.title: Google car: visible black car
lb-i6sF.summary: A black car showing at the bottom of the screen. It points to the area in and around Zahle.

lb-kaHF.title: Architecture: many modern high-rises
lb-kaHF.summary: The only covered city with lots of modern high-rises. Even when not directly in view, city buildings or roads show in the background.

lb-lWQ6.title: Coverage: snow on mountains
lb-lWQ6.summary: Snow on mountain tops or on the ground means the north-eastern mountains, east of Tripoli.

lb-p2gU.title: Architecture: sandstone brick buildings
lb-p2gU.summary: Many buildings are made of sandstone bricks. They look much like Jerusalem stone, common in Israel and the West Bank.

differs.how: Jerusalem stone looks very similar to Lebanese sandstone

lb-vjEC.title: Architecture: cubic white-painted buildings
lb-vjEC.summary: Lots of modern white-painted buildings with a very boxy look. It is a university campus.

lb-x8uj.title: Landscape: very flat farmland in the north
lb-x8uj.summary: In the north the land is very flat and agricultural, with mountains maybe visible to the southeast.
